preconditions.description: The number of rows in the first map must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns in the first map must be between 1 and 200.
The number of columns in the first map must be less than or equal to the number of rows.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == M for row in first_map)
preconditions.description: Each row in the first map must have exactly M characters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == N for row in second_map)
preconditions.description: Each row in the second map must have exactly N characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain two space-separated integers i and j, indicating the starting row and column of the M × M section.
The starting row index i must be within the valid range for the first map.
The starting column index j must be within the valid range for the second map.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map[i-1+k][j-1] == second_map[j-1+k][i-1] for k in range(M))
postconditions.description: The M × M section starting at row i in the first map must match the M × M section starting at column j in the second map.
